text: すうちが　たかいほど　あいてに　あたりやすく　なります。

structure.jp: すうちが　たかいほど
あいてに　あたりやすく　なります。
structure.en: the more easily it hits the opponent

patterns.name: 〜ほど
patterns.explanation: ほど after a describing word says 'the more this is so, the more the next thing happens'. たかいほど = 'the higher it is, the more...'.

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means 'easy to do' or 'likely to happen'. あたりやすく = 'hitting easily'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.span: あたりやすく　なります
patterns.explanation: A word ending in い changes to く before なる to say 'become' that way. あたりやすく なります = 'it becomes easier to hit'.
